title: ClaimAssessment v1
description: Adapter-layer exchange type: a domain assessment SUGGESTION for one claim payload and its evidence payloads — suggested claim_type, suggested disposition, an evidence-maturity CEILING (an upper bound, never a granted value), per-item reasons, and the domain rules that fired. An assessment never signs facts: promotion is decided by core evidence binding and the governance ladder, and adapters never write core records.

suggested_claim_type.description: One of the seven governance claim types (mirrors research-claim/v1 claim_type). A suggestion; the core claim record keeps the final word.

suggested_disposition.description: Suggested lifecycle disposition. inconclusive is a legitimate terminal suggestion and must never be forced into supported/refuted.

evidence_maturity_ceiling.description: Upper bound on the governance evidence ladder (docs/governance/RESEARCH_CLAIM_GOVERNANCE.md), not a granted maturity. Domain caps apply: pure numeric/computational math evidence without a proof certificate caps at engineering_verified; synthetic or sample quant evidence caps at data_accepted; production_observed is never granted by an adapter.

reasons.description: Per-item reasons for the suggestion. A suggestion without reasons is not assessable.

triggered_rules.description: Identifiers of the domain rules that fired. Required; write an explicit empty array when no rule fired.
